disclosure: Synthetic structural proof only. The cases test decision change, causal restraint, insight density, explanation burden, and creative-range preservation; they are not production receipts.

cases.input: Critique a supplied editorial portrait whose face, hands, and background all carry similar contrast.
cases.reporting_only: The portrait uses a muted palette, centered composition, soft light, and repeated high-contrast edges.

decision_intelligence.observation: VERIFIED from the supplied image: facial features, hands, and background edges compete at thumbnail size.
decision_intelligence.inference: The equal contrast likely splits the eye path, weakening the intended facial focal point.
alternatives: The distributed attention may be intentional to create unease.
The problem may be scale-specific rather than present at full resolution.
decision_intelligence.decision_delta: Preserve the composition and reduce only the background edge contrast before changing color, crop, or pose.
decision_intelligence.confirming_evidence: A grayscale thumbnail test produces a clear face-first eye path.
decision_intelligence.disconfirming_evidence: Viewers still enter through the hands, or the intended unsettled reading becomes weaker.
decision_intelligence.visible_result: One focal-hierarchy diagnosis, one reversible edit, and one thumbnail check.

cases.input: Synthesize five customer interviews that mention setup time, handoff confusion, and distrust of automated recommendations.
cases.reporting_only: Customers mentioned setup time three times, handoff confusion four times, and distrust twice.

decision_intelligence.observation: VERIFIED within the supplied interviews: handoff confusion spans four accounts and appears before trust complaints.
decision_intelligence.inference: The evidence suggests the adoption problem may be loss of ownership at the handoff, not automation aversion alone.
alternatives: The sample may overrepresent complex implementations.
Product reliability problems may be expressed as handoff distrust.
decision_intelligence.decision_delta: Test an owner-visible handoff and explanation step before investing in broader trust messaging.
decision_intelligence.confirming_evidence: Activation and retained use improve specifically for accounts receiving the revised handoff.
decision_intelligence.disconfirming_evidence: Trust objections remain unchanged after handoff clarity improves, or reliability incidents explain the pattern better.
decision_intelligence.visible_result: One cross-interview pattern, bounded mechanism, decision, and discriminating test.

cases.input: Interpret a worktree health report that says Sovereign Memory is missing and session/routing state is dormant.
cases.reporting_only: Sovereign Memory is MISSING; Session State and Routing Intelligence are DORMANT.

decision_intelligence.observation: VERIFIED: the first worktree readout lacked local runtime paths while canonical main contained the database, goals, and session-state files.
decision_intelligence.inference: The red status was primarily a lane-provisioning failure, not evidence that canonical memory had disappeared.
alternatives: The health script could intentionally ignore shared runtime state.
A link could exist but point to stale or incompatible data.
decision_intelligence.decision_delta: Bootstrap and re-run the same readout before repairing memory or feedback systems.
decision_intelligence.confirming_evidence: After bootstrap, Sovereign Memory, Session State, and Routing Intelligence become ACTIVE and constitution lint clears.
decision_intelligence.disconfirming_evidence: The same systems remain missing after valid links exist, or canonical main shows the same absence.
decision_intelligence.visible_result: Provisioning diagnosis, reversible repair, and before/after proof.

cases.input: Generate content directions from supplied audience notes showing operators celebrate AI speed but privately redo outputs they cannot defend.
cases.reporting_only: Topics: AI productivity, prompt tips, human oversight, quality control, and automation mistakes.

decision_intelligence.observation: VERIFIED within the supplied notes: public speed language coexists with private rework and accountability anxiety.
decision_intelligence.inference: The live tension is not human versus AI; it is borrowed speed versus owned judgment.
alternatives: Rework may reflect weak tools rather than accountability anxiety.
The notes may overrepresent expert operators with unusually high taste.
decision_intelligence.decision_delta: Explore three divergent concepts—confession, visual split-screen, and operating doctrine—around the same tension rather than publishing a generic prompt-tips list.
decision_intelligence.confirming_evidence: A small audience test produces recognition language about rework, defensibility, or ownership rather than generic AI agreement.
decision_intelligence.disconfirming_evidence: The audience responds only to tool-specific utility, or the accountability frame feels imposed rather than recognized.
decision_intelligence.visible_result: Signal, tension, three differentiated vessels, why-now relevance, and one recognition test without prescribing the final creative.
